name: ellipsis
summary: Truncates a single line of text with an ellipsis.

arguments.name: $display
accepts: a display keyword, or two or three in any order naming at most one outer type, one inner type and list-item, such as inline flex
a vendor keyword such as -webkit-box, a CSS-wide keyword, or var()
a quoted value is written without its quotes; a combination the browser drops, such as block inline, is refused
